title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.16984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on. We propose nameless tokenization, which leaves the control entries with a reserved identifier and no surface string, so the content encoder cannot emit one and message content reaches the model unaltered. Across five tokenizer families it reproduces the standard token stream exactly on attack-free data and lifts accuracy on a probe of delimiter-bearing text from 8.5% to 59.9%, where sanitizers lose it. translated_title: 无名分词化：一种针对开放权重LLM中控制标记伪造的无损分词器级防御
translated_abstract: 开放权重语言模型会公开其聊天模板中用于标记对话轮次、角色和工具结果的字符串，分词器会将这些字符串映射回模型所遵循的保留标识符。因此，任何能够控制提示词文本的人都可以写入一个与服务栈写入的完全无法区分的轮次边界。我们审计了256个已部署的聊天分词器，发现全部都可被伪造，而通常被推荐作为修复方案的标志位仍会使56.6%的分词器可被伪造，因为它遗漏了智能体系统所依赖的工具和推理标记。我们提出无名分词化方法，使控制条目保留保留标识符但没有表面字符串，因此内容编码器无法生成控制标记，消息内容可以未经改动地到达模型。在五个分词器系列上，该方法在无攻击数据上能完全复现标准令牌流，并将含分隔符文本探测任务的准确率从8.5%提升到59.9%，而清洗器方法则无法做到这一点。
tldr: 提出无名分词化方法，让控制条目只保留标识符而没有表面字符串，使内容编码器无法伪造控制标记，从而在完全无损标准令牌流的前提下，实现对开放权重LLM控制标记伪造攻击的防御。
en_tdlr: Nameless tokenization defends open-weight LLMs against control-token forgery in a lossless manner by giving control entries reserved identifiers with no surface string, preventing content encoders from emitting control tokens while exactly preserving standard token streams.
